title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state whether the copper wire will melt or not.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the energy stored in the capacitors using the formula E = 1/2 CV^2.

title: Resistance Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must determine the resistance of the wire based on its length and resistance per meter.

title: Heat Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the heat required to raise the wire's temperature to the melting point.

title: Comparison of Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compare the energy stored with the heat required to determine if melting occurs.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect unit conversions or miscalculating resistance.
